before.en: Hattusha’s walls, temples and royal buildings preserve the centre of a kingdom whose influence reached across Anatolia and into northern Syria. Monumental gateways and the rock sanctuary at Yazılıkaya made religion and political authority visible in the landscape. The city formed part of a wider world of competing Bronze Age powers. Its surviving buildings are evidence for organization, labor and ritual. Communities and successor kingdoms in the region continued after the capital’s imperial role ended.
before.zh: 哈图沙的城墙、神庙和王宫保存了一个影响安纳托利亚与叙利亚北部的王国中心。宏伟城门与雅兹勒卡亚石刻圣所将宗教和政治权威融入地景。它属于多个青铜时代强国竞争的世界。建筑体现组织、劳动和仪式；都城的帝国地位终结后，当地社区及后继王国仍然延续。

after.en:
Hattusha’s walls, temples and royal buildings preserve the centre of a kingdom whose influence reached across Anatolia and into northern Syria. Monumental gateways and the rock sanctuary at Yazılıkaya made religion and political authority visible in the landscape. The city formed part of a wider world of competing Bronze Age powers. Its surviving buildings are evidence for organization, labor and ritual. Communities and successor kingdoms in the region continued after the capital’s imperial role ended.

A silver stamp seal from Anatolia offers a smaller view of Hittite material culture. Dated to the fourteenth–thirteenth century BCE, it combines a handle with a hieroglyphic inscription. Its compact signs complement the monumental gateways of the capital; its owner and exact findspot are not established by the collection record.
after.zh:
哈图沙的城墙、神庙和王宫保存了一个影响安纳托利亚与叙利亚北部的王国中心。宏伟城门与雅兹勒卡亚石刻圣所将宗教和政治权威融入地景。它属于多个青铜时代强国竞争的世界。建筑体现组织、劳动和仪式；都城的帝国地位终结后，当地社区及后继王国仍然延续。

安纳托利亚的一枚银制戳印，提供了观察赫梯物质文化的另一种尺度。它约作于前十四至十三世纪，带柄，并刻有象形铭文。紧凑的符号与都城宏伟的塔门形成对照；馆藏记录未确定印章主人及确切出土地点。

before.en:
The Satavahanas were one of several powers that emerged after Mauryan rule fragmented. Their Deccan kingdom belonged to a political landscape shared with Shaka rulers and other regional dynasties. Its history helps replace the idea that the whole subcontinent passed from one empire to another.

Buddhist monuments and inscriptions preserve relationships among rulers, donors and religious communities. These sources do not describe a single state with unchanged boundaries. The northern Kushans and western Shaka rulers offer useful contemporary comparisons: connected trade and cultural worlds could coexist with political competition.
before.zh:
孔雀王朝统治瓦解之后，百乘王朝成为兴起的区域政权之一。其德干王国与塞种统治者及其他王朝共享一个多中心的政治世界。它的历史帮助我们跳出整个次大陆由一个帝国接替另一个帝国的想象。

佛教建筑和铭文留下王室、捐献者与宗教群体之间关系的线索。这些材料并不表示国家疆界始终不变。北方贵霜与西部塞种政权是可供同时比较的对象：贸易和文化联系能够与政治竞争并存。

after.en:
The Satavahanas were one of several powers that emerged after Mauryan rule fragmented. Their Deccan kingdom belonged to a political landscape shared with Shaka rulers and other regional dynasties.

Buddhist monuments and inscriptions preserve relationships among rulers, donors and religious communities. The northern Kushans and western Shaka rulers offer useful contemporary comparisons: connected trade and cultural worlds could coexist with political competition.

A copper-nickel portrait medallion, dated to about the first century CE and attributed to the Satavahana period, makes these wider connections tangible. The Met identifies it as probably from Maharashtra and possibly a cloak clasp. Its unnamed male bust has parallels in Parthian royal portraiture, suggesting how West Asian luxury objects could inspire local makers.
after.zh:
孔雀王朝统治瓦解之后，百乘王朝成为兴起的区域政权之一。其德干王国与塞种统治者及其他王朝共享一个多中心的政治世界。

佛教建筑和铭文留下王室、捐献者与宗教群体之间关系的线索。北方贵霜与西部塞种政权是可供同时比较的对象：贸易和文化联系能够与政治竞争并存。

一枚约公元一世纪、归属百乘时期的铜镍合金肖像圆饰，使这些广泛联系变得具体。大都会将其归于可能的马哈拉施特拉产地，并认为它可能是披风扣。未具名的男子半身像与帕提亚王室肖像存在相似之处，提示西亚奢侈品如何启发当地匠人。

before.en:
The Ghaznavid dynasty grew from the power of Turkic military commanders on the Samanid frontier. From Ghazni its rulers built a kingdom linking eastern Iranian lands with Afghanistan and northwestern South Asia. Its territories changed through campaigns, competition and the rise of neighboring powers.

Persian court culture and literary patronage accompanied military expansion. The Seljuq victory at Dandanakan in 1040 removed much of the western realm; later rulers survived farther east, ultimately in the Punjab. The Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 ended the remaining dynasty. A single broad empire outline would hide this shifting political geography.
before.zh:
伽色尼王朝兴起于萨曼边疆突厥军事统领的权力。统治者以伽色尼为基地，建立连接伊朗东部、阿富汗和南亚西北部的王国。领地随战争、竞争与邻国兴起而变化。

军事扩张伴随波斯宫廷文化和文学资助。1040年塞尔柱在丹丹干获胜，使其失去西部大部分领土；后继统治者在更东部、最终在旁遮普继续统治。1186年古尔攻占拉合尔，终结了余下王朝。用一张固定帝国轮廓无法表现这种变化。

after.en:
The Ghaznavid dynasty grew from the power of Turkic military commanders on the Samanid frontier. From Ghazni its rulers built a kingdom linking eastern Iranian lands with Afghanistan and northwestern South Asia. Its territories changed through campaigns, competition and the rise of neighboring powers.

Persian court culture and literary patronage accompanied military expansion. The Seljuq victory at Dandanakan in 1040 removed much of the western realm; later rulers survived farther east, ultimately in the Punjab. The Ghurid capture of Lahore in 1186 ended the remaining dynasty.

Craft objects preserve another kind of written culture. An eleventh-century high-tin bronze bowl, attributed to Afghanistan and probably Ghazni, carries Arabic maxims, good wishes and the name of its maker, Abu Nasr al-Naqqash. Its bright, resonant metal offered an alternative to silver. This surviving work adds an individual artisan to a history often told through military commanders and court patrons.
after.zh:
伽色尼王朝兴起于萨曼边疆突厥军事统领的权力。统治者以伽色尼为基地，建立连接伊朗东部、阿富汗和南亚西北部的王国。领地随战争、竞争与邻国兴起而变化。

军事扩张伴随波斯宫廷文化和文学资助。1040年塞尔柱在丹丹干获胜，使其失去西部大部分领土；后继统治者在更东部、最终在旁遮普继续统治。1186年古尔攻占拉合尔，终结了余下王朝。

工艺器物保留了另一种文字文化。一件十一世纪高锡青铜碗归属阿富汗、可能伽色尼，刻有阿拉伯文格言、祝愿与制作者阿布·纳斯尔·纳卡什的名字。明亮而音响清越的金属可作为白银的替代品。这件留存的作品，为常以军事统帅和宫廷赞助者为主的历史加入了一位具体匠人。

title.en: Shiva or a guardian in Cham stone carving
title.zh: 占婆石雕中的湿婆或守门神

alt.en: A standing stone figure with a tall headdress and short wrap holds an object beside one shoulder.
alt.zh: 站立石像戴高冠、着短裙，一侧肩旁持物。

caption.en: Cham stone sculpture, first half of the tenth century, identified as Shiva or a temple guardian; Met 1987.478.
caption.zh: 占婆石雕，十世纪上半叶，识别为湿婆或寺庙守门神；大都会1987.478。

interpretation.en: The Met dates the carving by comparison with temple sculpture at My Son and Khoung My. The figure’s identity remains uncertain, and the record does not establish a My Son findspot.
interpretation.zh: 大都会通过与美山及姜美寺庙雕刻比较为其断代。像主身份仍有不确定性，记录也未确认其出土于美山。
